user.title: Connect Octopus Intelligent Go
user.description: Sign in with your Octopus Energy Spain account. Your password is used only to obtain a refresh token and is not stored. Refresh-token rotation is saved automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Octopus Intelligent Go
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with your Octopus Energy Spain account to replace the expired refresh token. Your password is not stored; future token rotations are saved automatically.

reconfigure.title: Update Octopus Intelligent Go authentication
reconfigure.description: Sign in with your Octopus Energy Spain account to obtain a fresh refresh token. Your password is not stored; future token rotations are saved automatically.

error.no_accounts: No Octopus accounts were found for this login.
error.no_devices: No compatible Intelligent Go devices were found for this account.
